usage: agentbreeder eval [-h] --endpoint ENDPOINT [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                         [--only ONLY] [--retries RETRIES]
                         [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] [--stack DIR]
                         agent

positional arguments:
  agent

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --endpoint ENDPOINT
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --only ONLY           Comma-separated case IDs
  --retries RETRIES
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
